key_idea: With N,M<=2000 there are only 4e6 entry/exit pairs, so enumerate every non-negative difference and take the most frequent one.
sketch: Collect exit-entry for all pairs with exit>=entry into an array (up to 4e6 ints), sort it, and scan runs to find the longest; because the scan is in ascending order and only strictly longer runs replace the best, ties resolve to the smallest value. O(NM log(NM)), about 0.1 s. Pitfalls: negative differences must be discarded, and if no non-negative difference exists every candidate has zero correspondences so the answer is 0. Timestamps are distinct per detector, so each pair counts one correspondence per difference.
